design.mobile_navigation: 64px header and 72px fixed bottom nav up to 600px
design.timer: Laurel of effort: two branches of vector leaves plus 100-unit radius inner phase progress line; current-phase progress drives fill; SVG viewBox 320x320.
design.focus_phase: Blue inner progress, explicit Focus label; bronze laurel progress accent
design.rest_phase: Bronze inner progress, explicit Rest label; bronze laurel progress accent
design.paused: explicit Paused status; static laurel progress remains unchanged
design.session_configuration: editable only before start; active session shows compact read-only details
design.mobile: Approved refinement: compact configuration below the timer; use available height without unnecessary scrolling and allow scrolling when content cannot fit

source_of_truth.rule: The prototype, snapshots, and canonical_viewports geometry document the original concept. Later approved Flutter layout refinements and docs/focus-timer-domain-rules.md take precedence; the prototype does not depict No rest.

interaction_contract.one_cycle: one positive Focus period, optionally followed by a positive Rest period; zero Rest means focus-only, with no skip action
interaction_contract.pause_resume: both Focus and Rest phases can be paused/resumed
interaction_contract.reset: available only when paused; dialog Save partial / Discard / Cancel
interaction_contract.natural_completion: persist and notify, then return to setup; zero Rest completes directly after Focus without a Rest-start alert
interaction_contract.configuration: Work Area, positive Focus minutes and non-negative Rest minutes selected before cycle; 0 displays No rest; choices grouped by Focus Areas / Special Activities
interaction_contract.time_source: in production use existing Riverpod state and timestamp-based accurate timer; HTML demo is illustrative
interaction_contract.active_phase_feedback: always convey via visible label, not color alone
interaction_contract.motion: phase progress follows timer state; pause decorative motion and respect reduced-motion settings
interaction_contract.accessibility: 48px touch targets where possible, keyboard focus, labels, semantically descriptive status
interaction_contract.do_not_change: backend, state machine, phase transitions, persistence, notification logic, business rules

implementation_steps: Refine timer ring and phase transition motion
Update Flutter goldens only after approval
sample_data_warning: All displayed times, activities and labels are illustrative. Bind Flutter UI to existing live Riverpod/controller values. Do not hardcode sample statistics.
